content.text: Now I'll rebuild the CI commit, check it, and push.

arguments.command:
set -e
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1
cat >> .github/workflows/ci.yml <<'EOF'

  commitlint:
    # Every commit of a pull request follows commitlint.config.js, whoever made it (pi included). Hooks can be
    # skipped with --no-verify; this check cannot.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Check commit messages
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: npx --no -- commitlint --from "$BASE_SHA" --to "$HEAD_SHA" --verbose
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
def edit(p,a,b):
    s=open(p).read(); assert a in s,(p,a); open(p,'w').write(s.replace(a,b))
edit('AGENTS.md'," [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) has the rules."," The `commitlint` job in [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks every commit of a pull request with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js). `git commit --no-verify` does not skip it.")
edit('CONTRIBUTING.md',"| Runs `npm run check` on pushes and pull requests to `main` |","| Runs `npm run check` on pushes and pull requests to `main`. On pull requests, the `commitlint` job checks the message of each commit with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) |")
edit('knip.json','],\n\t"ignoreDependencies": ["@commitlint/cli"]\n','],\n')
EOF
npx oxfmt knip.json >/dev/null
git add -A && git commit -q --no-verify -m "ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint

The commitlint job runs commitlint.config.js over the commits between
the base and the head of the pull request. Unlike a commit-msg hook,
git commit --no-verify cannot skip it, so the rule applies to everyone,
pi included. knip now sees @commitlint/cli in use, so drop it from
ignoreDependencies.

Refs #38"
npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo check=$?
npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD; echo commitlint=$?
git push -q --force-with-lease origin feat/38-no-agent-hooks 2>&1 | tail -2; git log --oneline -1 origin/feat/38-no-agent-hooks
